scripts.db:up: docker compose up -d postgres && DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://carddemo:carddemo_local_only@localhost:5432/carddemo} node scripts/wait-for-db.js
scripts.reset: docker compose down -v && npm run db:up
scripts.test:db:create: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U carddemo -d postgres -c 'CREATE DATABASE carddemo_test;' || true
scripts.test:db:drop: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U carddemo -d postgres -c 'DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS carddemo_test;'
